plain_description: The big picture: Meta's Llama 3 gives businesses and creators access to powerful large language models (8B to 70B parameters) for building AI applications. Here's why it matters: you can run pre-trained and instruction-tuned models locally for text generation and chat, with model weights and inference code provided. The bottom line: this repo is deprecated in favor of the newer Llama 3.1 / Llama Stack ecosystem.
technical_description: This repository provides model weights and inference code for Meta Llama 3, a family of auto-regressive language models ranging from 8B to 70B parameters. It supports pre-trained (base) and instruction-tuned variants with sequence lengths up to 8192 tokens. Inference requires PyTorch with CUDA and uses torchrun with model parallelism (MP=1 for 8B, MP=8 for 70B). The codebase includes example scripts for text completion and chat completion with a specific chat format using special tokens. Models are distributed as native weights downloadable via a signed URL or Hugging Face, and the repo is deprecated in favor of the consolidated Llama Stack repositories.
title: Llama 3
